segments.t: Barinov has heard something, and he leads Max away to his office for a talk. Max is nervous, and the chef sounds severe. Have a listen first.
Пойдём со мной в мой кабинет.
Заходи в комнату и закрой дверь.
Сядь на стул и слушай меня.
Пойдём со мной в мой кабинет.
'Come with me into my office.' "Let's go" is the one from the dining room. "With me" is the form with the extra vowel. "Office" is a room for work. Barinov leads, and Max follows.
'Chef, where are we going now?' "Where to" is the question about direction. Max uses "we" and "go" on foot. His voice is small, and the question shows he's afraid of the answer.

'We need a very serious conversation.' "To us needed" is the pattern, here masculine, because "conversation" is masculine. The Russian for "conversation" is built on the term for "talk". Barinov sounds grave.
'Did you hear everything in the kitchen?' Max uses the polite "you", so "heard" ends in -li, the plural ending. Russian does this even for one person. Max asks, because he has to know.
'I heard every word of yours.' This time it is Barinov's own "I heard", with the man's -l. "Every" and "your" are in front of "word". The sentence has a smile in it, and a threat.
'I myself do not understand anything.' "I myself" is a way to say "I too". Max's "do not understand nothing" has the usual double negative. He appeals to the chef's pity.
'You caused a real big scandal.' "Arranged" is how Russian says "staged" or "caused". "Scandal" is a borrowed word. Barinov chooses big words, because he is enjoying himself.
'I did not want to offend anyone.' "Offend" is back from the caviar scene. "Nobody" gets its own form after "not". Max defends himself, and the defence is sincere.
Заходи в комнату и закрой дверь.
'Go into the room and close the door.' "Go in" covers dropping in. "Close" returns from the hide-and-seek rules. The chef wants privacy, and the door is the sign of it.
'Good, I am already closing the door.' "I am closing" shows the action in progress, where "close" shows a single act. Russian keeps the two apart. Max does as he is told.
Сядь на стул и слушай меня.
'Sit on a chair and listen to me.' "Sit down" equals Vika's order to Alisa. "Listen" is the plain command. Barinov arranges the room for a lecture.
'I am listening to you attentively, chef.' Max says the same phrase that Barinov used with the TV woman. He uses the polite "you". It's his best behaviour.

'Now your life will change greatly.' "Will change" has the -sya, "change itself". "Life" is related to "alive". Barinov says it like a prophecy, and it is also a threat. Now let's hear it once more, start to finish.
Пойдём со мной в мой кабинет.
Заходи в комнату и закрой дверь.
Сядь на стул и слушай меня.
The door is closed, and Max is sitting down. The chef's lecture is about to begin. Enjoy the rest of the episode.
